calls.title: Ashley & Patrick Dudley
calls.summary: Growth Book is rapidly scaling its marketing systems to support ambitious growth targets, with Ashley Stirrup establishing core marketing infrastructure like lead magnets and ad campaigns, including a successful webinar with 750 registrants. The lead management strategy focuses on segmented outreach based on account scoring to improve conversion rates. Product development is centered on enhancing the beta product analytics feature, which targets smaller customers, alongside a significant investment in AI capabilities that streamline experimentation and internal processes. Sales leader Patrick Dudley highlighted his data-driven sales experience and closing a notable $750,000 deal with Victoria’s Secret while emphasizing the importance of close collaboration between sales and marketing to optimize lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
calls.keywords: Marketing infrastructure, Lead nurturing, AI experimentation, Sales personalization, Product analytics, Multi-threaded sales
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Continue scaling marketing infrastructure including lead routing, tracking, and campaign development to support growth goals (01:33)
Strengthen and market product analytics, managed warehouse offerings, and AI experimentation capabilities to drive new revenue streams (08:02)
Develop and execute tiered lead outreach strategies differentiating A, B, and C level accounts with sales and marketing teams (06:14)

**Patrick Dudley**
Prepare for potential hybrid role at Growth Book involving inbound lead management, prospecting, and cross-sell/upsell opportunities; remain adaptable to evolving org needs (14:51)
Leverage competitive experience and AI-based personalized outreach strategies to add value in sales role and support team goals at Growth Book (15:35)
Use prior success in strategic multi-threaded deal management to assist Growth Book in closing complex enterprise accounts (21:29)
